# Diaporama 

Create diaporama from quarto doument to revealjs.  
https://quarto.org/docs/presentations/revealjs/  

## 1st Page
---
title: "Presentation title"
author: "Vincyane BADOUARD"
format:
  revealjs:
    logo: logo.png # logo on the slide
    footer: "Footer text"
theme: dark
incremental: true # to display bullet point step-by-step
 smaller: true # to reduce slide text size
    scrollable: true # to scroll slide text
---

## Structure
### New slide
- Create a new slide with just a title: **# Slide Title **
- Create a new slide with a title: **## Slide Title **  
- Create a new slide without title: **---**

### Multiple Columns
:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="40%"}
Left column
:::

::: {.column width="60%"}
Right column
:::

::::

### Content
- Add a footnote:

::: aside
Some additional commentary of more peripheral interest.
:::

- Add a numbered footnote:
**text^[the footnote]**


## Slide too small
- Reduce text size of the slide: **## Slide Title {.smaller}**
- To scroll the content: **## Slide Title {.scrollable}**

## Display options
- incremental list only on a slide: 
::: {.incremental} 
- step 1
- step 2
:::
- non incremental: **{.nonincremental}**
- Display text step by step on a slide: **. . .**

## Speaker Notes
::: {.notes}
Speaker notes go here.
:::
- Press **S** on the presentation to open the presentation speaker view
